question: List the names of customers from Delhi.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Delhi';

question: What is the total revenue from all orders?
For each customer who has placed orders, show the customer name and the number of orders.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name;

question: Which product category has the most products?
gold_sql: SELECT category FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show the 3 most expensive products with their prices.
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which customers have bought a product from the Electronics category?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics';

question: How many orders were placed in the last quarter of 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01';
